name: Basing House
summary: A late-licensed music venue at the southern end of Kingsland Road, in Shoreditch, with an intimate 300-capacity room. It has been open since 2010.

music.notes: Club nights every Friday and Saturday, put on with outside promoters and labels.

crowd: The venue describes its guests as music lovers who want a close-up, quality clubbing night.

cost.notes: Bar payments are card only, but entry can still be paid in cash at the door; stowed items are paid for by card.

evidence.quote: Located at the vibrant south end of Kingsland Road in Shoreditch
Intimate, late-licensed, Funktion One equipped, East London venue.
a go-to destination for music lovers seeking an up-close, high-quality clubbing experience with real character

a rotating roster of top-tier external promoters and forward-thinking labels
